// diagnostic

E3221

Jet's x86-64 template assembler has no encoding for `{mnemonic}`

What

Jet's x86-64 template assembler has no encoding for `{mnemonic}`

Why

An `#FFI(asm)` body is assembled by the compiler's own x86-64 encoder, which encodes only the instructions it lists, so this line has no bytes to emit

Fix

Use an instruction the template assembler encodes, or write this code in an `#FFI(c)` body

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3221: tests/ui/ffi_asm_unencoded_mnemonic.stderr.

Error [jet.AsmUnencodedMnemonic]: Jet's x86-64 template assembler has no encoding for `bswap`
  --> tests/ui/ffi_asm_unencoded_mnemonic.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     bswap rax ; -> return
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: An `#FFI(asm)` body is assembled by the compiler's own x86-64 encoder, which encodes only the instructions it lists, so this line has no bytes to emit
 Fix: Use an instruction the template assembler encodes, or write this code in an `#FFI(c)` body
